entities.name: Eduard von der Ropp
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edward Ropp was a Polish nobleman of Baltic German origins, Bishop of Vilnius and Roman Catholic metropolitan archbishop of Mogilev. He was born 2 December 1851 near Līksna in present-day Latvia and died on 25 July 1939 in Poznań, Poland.
